Macrocytic hypochromic - small and pale RBCs; caused by iron deficiency, haemoglobinopathies like SCA and thalassemia and sideroblastic anaemia (defective heme synthesis)

snip.t: Other maternal illness: Cyanotic heart disease, haemoglobinopathies (sickle cell), kidney disease, SLE
Family / past medical: Family history of haemoglobinopathies, previous anaemia, surgeries (gastric bypass). — Genetic conditions or prior surgeries can affect iron metabolism or loss.
Heterozygous HbAS (trait) + other haemoglobinopathies (e.g., HbC): Can modify severity when co‑inherited
Falsely low in haemolytic anaemia, haemoglobinopathies.
